name: Toudou Tatsuko
source:
She is fairly tall and although she looks quite stern she is actually kind and dependable. She has a huge fan following in the school comprising of both girls and guys. She is in love with [url=http://vndb.org/c1275]Katsumi[/url] and if the player is also going for his ending she can become a rival in love for his affections. She works part-time at Stallion Gasoline station.
